 import { defineSchema, defineTable } from "convex/server";
 import { v } from "convex/values";
 
 import { decisionValidator } from "../src/lib/decision";
 
 export default defineSchema({
   institutions: defineTable({
     name: v.string(),
     code: v.string(),
     createdAt: v.number(),
   }).index("by_code", ["code"]),
 
   users: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     email: v.string(),
     name: v.string(),
     usn: v.optional(v.string()),
     role: v.union(
       v.literal("student"),
       v.literal("faculty"),
       v.literal("department_authority"),
       v.literal("admin"),
       v.literal("auditor"),
     ),
     status: v.optional(v.union(v.literal("invited"), v.literal("active"), v.literal("suspended"))),
     createdAt: v.number(),
   })
     .index("by_institution", ["institutionId"])
     .index("by_email", ["email"])
     .index("by_institution_usn", ["institutionId", "usn"]),
 
   password_credentials: defineTable({
     userId: v.id("users"),
     hash: v.string(),
     createdAt: v.number(),
     updatedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
   }).index("by_user", ["userId"]),
 
   password_login_attempts: defineTable({
     subjectKey: v.string(),
     institutionId: v.optional(v.id("institutions")),
     attempts: v.number(),
     windowStartAt: v.number(),
   }).index("by_subjectKey", ["subjectKey"]),
 
   courses: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     code: v.string(),
     title: v.string(),
     department: v.optional(v.string()),
   }).index("by_institution_code", ["institutionId", "code"]),
 
   sections: defineTable({
     courseId: v.id("courses"),
     name: v.string(),
     term: v.optional(v.string()),
   }).index("by_course", ["courseId"]),
 
   venues: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     name: v.string(),
     capacity: v.optional(v.number()),
     latitude: v.optional(v.number()),
     longitude: v.optional(v.number()),
     geofenceRadiusMeters: v.optional(v.number()),
   }).index("by_institution", ["institutionId"]),
 
   timetable_slots: defineTable({
     sectionId: v.id("sections"),
     venueId: v.id("venues"),
     dayOfWeek: v.number(),
     startMinutes: v.number(),
     endMinutes: v.number(),
     facultyId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
   })
     .index("by_section", ["sectionId"])
     .index("by_venue", ["venueId"])
     .index("by_faculty_day", ["facultyId", "dayOfWeek"]),
 
   enrollments: defineTable({
     studentId: v.id("users"),
     sectionId: v.id("sections"),
     enrolledAt: v.number(),
   })
     .index("by_student", ["studentId"])
     .index("by_section", ["sectionId"]),
 
   attendance_events: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     studentId: v.id("users"),
     sectionId: v.id("sections"),
     sessionId: v.optional(v.id("class_sessions")),
     state: v.union(
       v.literal("initiated"),
       v.literal("authenticated"),
       v.literal("session_verified"),
       v.literal("presence_evaluated"),
       v.literal("risk_evaluated"),
       v.literal("step_up"),
       v.literal("verified"),
       v.literal("flagged"),
       v.literal("rejected"),
       v.literal("corrected"),
     ),
     origin: v.union(v.literal("online"), v.literal("offline-faculty"), v.literal("mobile")),
     policyVersion: v.optional(v.string()),
     seq: v.number(),
     prevEventHash: v.optional(v.string()),
     eventHash: v.string(),
     correctsEventId: v.optional(v.id("attendance_events")),
     decision: v.optional(decisionValidator),
     capturedAt: v.number(),
     recordedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
     note: v.optional(v.string()),
     syncNonceHash: v.optional(v.string()),
   })
     .index("by_student_section", ["studentId", "sectionId"])
     .index("by_section_captured", ["sectionId", "capturedAt"])
     .index("by_section_state", ["sectionId", "state"])
     .index("by_institution_seq", ["institutionId", "seq"])
     .index("by_capturedAt", ["capturedAt"])
     .index("by_corrects_event", ["correctsEventId"])
     .index("by_nonce_hash", ["syncNonceHash"]),
 
   invites: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     email: v.string(),
     role: v.union(
       v.literal("student"),
       v.literal("faculty"),
       v.literal("department_authority"),
       v.literal("admin"),
       v.literal("auditor"),
     ),
     tokenHash: v.string(),
     status: v.union(
       v.literal("pending"),
       v.literal("accepted"),
       v.literal("revoked"),
       v.literal("expired"),
     ),
     invitedByUserId: v.id("users"),
     createdAt: v.number(),
     expiresAt: v.number(),
     acceptedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
     acceptedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
   })
     .index("by_tokenHash", ["tokenHash"])
     .index("by_institution_status", ["institutionId", "status"])
     .index("by_email", ["email"]),
 
   passkey_credentials: defineTable({
     userId: v.id("users"),
     credentialId: v.string(),
     publicKey: v.string(),
     counter: v.number(),
     transports: v.optional(v.array(v.string())),
     label: v.optional(v.string()),
     createdAt: v.number(),
     lastUsedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
     revokedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
   })
     .index("by_credentialId", ["credentialId"])
     .index("by_user", ["userId"]),
 
   devices: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     userId: v.id("users"),
     label: v.string(),
     platform: v.optional(v.string()),
     state: v.union(
       v.literal("new"),
       v.literal("enrolled"),
       v.literal("active"),
       v.literal("suspended"),
       v.literal("revoked"),
       v.literal("replaced"),
     ),
     replacesDeviceId: v.optional(v.id("devices")),
     replacedByDeviceId: v.optional(v.id("devices")),
     registeredAt: v.number(),
     activatedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
     stateChangedAt: v.number(),
     stateReason: v.optional(v.string()),
   })
     .index("by_user", ["userId"])
     .index("by_institution_state", ["institutionId", "state"])
     .index("by_institution_state_registered", ["institutionId", "state", "registeredAt"]),
 
   auth_challenges: defineTable({
     challenge: v.string(),
     purpose: v.union(v.literal("registration"), v.literal("authentication")),
     userId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
     expiresAt: v.number(),
     consumedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
   })
     .index("by_challenge", ["challenge"])
     .index("by_expiresAt", ["expiresAt"]),
 
   sessions: defineTable({
     userId: v.id("users"),
     tokenHash: v.string(),
     credentialId: v.optional(v.string()),
     createdAt: v.number(),
     expiresAt: v.number(),
     revokedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
     lastSeenAt: v.optional(v.number()),
     lastStepUpAt: v.optional(v.number()),
   })
     .index("by_tokenHash", ["tokenHash"])
     .index("by_user", ["userId"])
     .index("by_expiresAt", ["expiresAt"]),
 
   device_verifications: defineTable({
     deviceId: v.id("devices"),
     codeHash: v.string(),
     expiresAt: v.number(),
     attempts: v.number(),
     consumedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
   }).index("by_device", ["deviceId"]),
 
   replacement_requests: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     studentId: v.id("users"),
     oldDeviceId: v.id("devices"),
     reason: v.string(),
     status: v.union(v.literal("pending"), v.literal("approved"), v.literal("rejected")),
     requestedAt: v.number(),
     decidedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
     decidedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
     successorDeviceId: v.optional(v.id("devices")),
   })
     .index("by_status", ["status"])
     .index("by_student", ["studentId"])
     .index("by_status_requested", ["status", "requestedAt"])
     .index("by_institution_status_requested", ["institutionId", "status", "requestedAt"]),
 
   biometric_records: defineTable({
     userId: v.id("users"),
     consentVersion: v.string(),
     consentedAt: v.number(),

     faceEnrolledAt: v.optional(v.number()),

   verification_challenges: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     sessionId: v.id("class_sessions"),
     studentId: v.id("users"),
     kind: v.union(v.literal("checkin_stepup"), v.literal("spot_recheck")),
     originEventId: v.optional(v.id("attendance_events")),
     requestedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),

       v.literal("failed"),
       v.literal("expired"),
       v.literal("escalated"),

     createdAt: v.number(),
     expiresAt: v.number(),

   })
     .index("by_student_status", ["studentId", "status"])
     .index("by_session_status", ["sessionId", "status"])
     .index("by_status_expires", ["status", "expiresAt"]),
 
   event_ledger: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     category: v.union(v.literal("device"), v.literal("identity"), v.literal("attendance")),
     type: v.string(),
     actorUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
     subjectUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
     deviceId: v.optional(v.id("devices")),
     payload: v.any(),
     seq: v.number(),
     prevEventHash: v.optional(v.string()),
     eventHash: v.string(),
     createdAt: v.number(),
   })
     .index("by_institution_seq", ["institutionId", "seq"])
     .index("by_subject", ["subjectUserId"])
     .index("by_subject_created", ["subjectUserId", "createdAt"])
     .index("by_subject_category_type_created", ["subjectUserId", "category", "type", "createdAt"])
     .index("by_device", ["deviceId"])
     .index("by_createdAt", ["createdAt"]),
 
   class_sessions: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     courseId: v.id("courses"),
     sectionId: v.id("sections"),
     venueId: v.id("venues"),
     facultyId: v.id("users"),
     kind: v.union(v.literal("scheduled"), v.literal("guest")),
     timetableSlotId: v.optional(v.id("timetable_slots")),
     status: v.union(v.literal("active"), v.literal("paused"), v.literal("closed")),

     restartOfSessionId: v.optional(v.id("class_sessions")),
-    offlineKeyHash: v.optional(v.string()),
+    offlineKey: v.optional(v.string()),
   })
     .index("by_faculty_status", ["facultyId", "status"])
     .index("by_section_started", ["sectionId", "startedAt"])
     .index("by_institution_status", ["institutionId", "status"])
     .index("by_status_windowEndsAt", ["status", "windowEndsAt"])
     .index("by_windowEndsAt", ["windowEndsAt"]),
 
   session_challenges: defineTable({
     institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
     sessionId: v.id("class_sessions"),
     nonceHash: v.string(),

   })

   access_requests: defineTable({

CONTEXT: Phase 5 correction workflow per docs/report.md §12: student dispute → routed to recording faculty → decision → NEW attendance event referencing the original; history is never rewritten. Spec table: original event preserved; audit record retains actor, time, reason, previous state, new state.

FOUNDATION ALREADY LANDED (read these first):
- `src/lib/attendance/lifecycle.ts`: ATTENDANCE_STATES, CORRECTIONABLE_STATES = ["verified","flagged","rejected"], AttendanceEventState.

(v.id class_sessions), eventId? (v.id attendance_events), decision? ("approved"|"dismissed"). Indexes: by_student_requested, by_student_status_requested, by_institution_status.
- `convex/attendanceRequests.ts` currently has submitMyRequest + listMyRequests (student-scoped). The admin requests page exists at `src/app/(admin)/admin/requests/`.
- `Decision` type lives in `src/lib/decision.ts` (read it — corrected events need a full Decision object).
- Faculty session flow: `convex/classSessions.ts` — sessions carry facultyId; `verifyManually` there is the closest pattern for an attributable override writing both event_ledger entry + appendAttendanceEvent row.
- Student UI: `src/app/(student)/student/requests/page.tsx` + requests-manager.tsx; history page `src/app/(student)/student/history/`. Faculty surfaces under `src/app/(faculty)/faculty/`; check `src/lib/auth/nav.ts` for how role nav items are declared.

BUILD:

1. STUDENT DISPUTE (`convex/attendanceRequests.ts`, extend submitMyRequest):
   - For type="correction": require `eventId: v.id("attendance_events")`. Validate: the event belongs to the caller (event.studentId === caller._id), its state ∈ CORRECTIONABLE_STATES, it has no existing correction yet (query by_corrects_event), and no other open correction request targets the same eventId. Stamp the request with eventId AND sessionId (event.sessionId — if undefined reject with clear ConvexError; all current writers set sessionId).
   - exemption/on_duty stay as-is (no linkage required).
2. ROUTING + REVIEW QUERIES:
   - New query for the recording faculty: submitted correction requests routed to them. Route = request.sessionId → session.facultyId === caller._id (join via class_sessions; also return session/course/student display info). Admin sees everything (extend the existing admin requests query/pattern instead if one exists — check how admin/requests/page.tsx gets data today and extend that path rather than duplicating).
   - Include the disputed event's current state/outcome summary so the reviewer sees previous state without leaving the queue.
3. REVIEW DECISION mutation (faculty who teaches the session; admin fallback allowed):
   - approve → within ONE transaction: mark request approved (+reviewedByUserId, reviewedAt, decision:"approved", optional review note appended to a new optional `reviewNote?` field — check schema; if absent, fold note into existing note/reason storage instead of schema edits), then call `appendAttendanceEvent` with state:"corrected", correctsEventId=request.eventId, decision built as outcome "accept" (read src/lib/risk/engine.ts's outcomeToAttendanceState mapping to confirm "accept"→"verified" projection semantics), policyVersion from the ORIGINAL event's decision.policyVersion (preserve policy context per §12), reasonCodes like ["faculty_correction"], recordedByUserId=reviewer, note = student reason + reviewer note, origin "online".
   - dismiss → mark dismissed (+reviewedByUserId/reviewedAt/decision:"dismissed"); no attendance change.
   - Both emit event_ledger entries via internal.ledger.appendLedgerEvent: type "attendance_request_reviewed" with payload {requestId, decision, eventId, previousState}.
   - Idempotence guard: approving an already-approved/dismissed request throws; approving when the event was already corrected throws clean error.
4. STUDENT QUERY: extend listMyRequests to include the linked event/session labels (course code, session date, disputed event state, and post-review outcome) so the requests UI can show what happened.
5. UI (match existing component style — read neighboring pages first):
   - Student requests page: correction-type submissions gain an event picker — new small query listing the student's recent CORRECTIONABLE events (their history rows: label = course + capturedAt + state) to attach to a dispute. Show request status badges approved/dismissed (badge handling was just updated for the new statuses) and post-decision outcome.
   - Faculty: add a review surface — minimal honest placement: a "Review queue" section on the faculty dashboard (`src/app/(faculty)/faculty/page.tsx`) listing routed disputes with reason, disputed event context, approve/dismiss controls (server actions/mutations like existing review-button pattern under admin/requests/review-button.tsx — mirror it).
   - Admin requests page: ensure the new statuses/linkage render correctly.
6. TESTS: unit-test what's pure. If the routing/approval logic requires DB, keep logic thin and rely on e2e later; but extract any pure helpers (e.g. building the corrected Decision from an original event) into a testable module `src/lib/attendance/correction.ts` with vitest tests in tests/correction.test.ts (@vitest-environment node).

3: /**
4:  * Full attendance event lifecycle. The first five states are pipeline
5:  * intermediates a progressive writer may emit while evidence accumulates;
6:  * the next four are decision states today's single-shot writers produce;
7:  * "corrected" only ever overwrites an earlier decision event.
8:  */
9: export const ATTENDANCE_STATES = [
10:   "initiated",
11:   "authenticated",
12:   "session_verified",
13:   "presence_evaluated",
14:   "risk_evaluated",
15:   "step_up",
16:   "verified",
17:   "flagged",
18:   "rejected",
19:   "corrected",
20: ] as const;
21: 
22: export type AttendanceEventState = (typeof ATTENDANCE_STATES)[number];
23: 
24: export const ATTENDANCE_ORIGINS = ["online", "offline-faculty", "mobile"] as const;
25: 
26: export type AttendanceOrigin = (typeof ATTENDANCE_ORIGINS)[number];
27: 
28: /** Terminal decision states that a correction may overwrite. */
29: export const CORRECTIONABLE_STATES = ["verified", "flagged", "rejected"] as const;
30: 
31: export type CorrectionableState = (typeof CORRECTIONABLE_STATES)[number];
32: 
33: /** Intermediates advance one step at a time before landing on a decision state. */
34: const PIPELINE_PROGRESSION: readonly AttendanceEventState[] = [
35:   "initiated",
36:   "authenticated",
37:   "session_verified",
38:   "presence_evaluated",
39:   "risk_evaluated",
40: ];
41: 
42: const DECISION_STATES: readonly AttendanceEventState[] = [
43:   "step_up",
44:   "verified",
45:   "flagged",
46:   "rejected",
47: ];
48: 
49: /** Every state except "corrected" may begin an attempt entry; corrections overwrite existing ones. */
50: export function isStartableState(state: AttendanceEventState): boolean {
51:   return state !== "corrected";
52: }
53: 
54: /** An entry is state "corrected" iff it carries correctsEventId; regular events must not. */
55: export function isValidCorrection(
56:   state: AttendanceEventState,
57:   correctsEventId: string | undefined,
58: ): boolean {
59:   if (state === "corrected") return correctsEventId !== undefined;
60:   return correctsEventId === undefined;
61: }

63: /**
64:  * Whether `next` may follow `prev` in the progressive check-in pipeline.
65:  * Intermediates move one step forward; any intermediate may jump straight to
66:  * a decision state (the shape single-shot writers produce). Corrections are
67:  * overwrites of settled decisions, not pipeline steps, so they never follow.
68:  */
69: export function canFollowInPipeline(
70:   prev: AttendanceEventState,
71:   next: AttendanceEventState,
72: ): boolean {
73:   const prevIndex = PIPELINE_PROGRESSION.indexOf(prev);
74:   if (prevIndex === -1) return false;
75:   if (next === "corrected") return false;
76:   if (DECISION_STATES.includes(next)) return true;
77:   return PIPELINE_PROGRESSION.indexOf(next) === prevIndex + 1;
78: }

import { defineSchema, defineTable } from "convex/server";
import { v } from "convex/values";

import { decisionValidator } from "../src/lib/decision";

export default defineSchema({
  institutions: defineTable({
    name: v.string(),
    code: v.string(),
    createdAt: v.number(),
  }).index("by_code", ["code"]),

  users: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    email: v.string(),
    name: v.string(),
    usn: v.optional(v.string()),
    role: v.union(
      v.literal("student"),
      v.literal("faculty"),
      v.literal("department_authority"),
      v.literal("admin"),
      v.literal("auditor"),
    ),
    status: v.optional(v.union(v.literal("invited"), v.literal("active"), v.literal("suspended"))),
    createdAt: v.number(),
  })
    .index("by_institution", ["institutionId"])
    .index("by_email", ["email"])
    .index("by_institution_usn", ["institutionId", "usn"]),

  password_credentials: defineTable({
    userId: v.id("users"),
    hash: v.string(),
    createdAt: v.number(),
    updatedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
  }).index("by_user", ["userId"]),

  password_login_attempts: defineTable({
    subjectKey: v.string(),
    institutionId: v.optional(v.id("institutions")),
    attempts: v.number(),
    windowStartAt: v.number(),
  }).index("by_subjectKey", ["subjectKey"]),

  courses: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    code: v.string(),
    title: v.string(),
    department: v.optional(v.string()),
  }).index("by_institution_code", ["institutionId", "code"]),

  sections: defineTable({
    courseId: v.id("courses"),
    name: v.string(),
    term: v.optional(v.string()),
  }).index("by_course", ["courseId"]),

  venues: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    name: v.string(),
    capacity: v.optional(v.number()),
    latitude: v.optional(v.number()),
    longitude: v.optional(v.number()),
    geofenceRadiusMeters: v.optional(v.number()),
  }).index("by_institution", ["institutionId"]),

  timetable_slots: defineTable({
    sectionId: v.id("sections"),
    venueId: v.id("venues"),
    dayOfWeek: v.number(),
    startMinutes: v.number(),
    endMinutes: v.number(),
    facultyId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
  })
    .index("by_section", ["sectionId"])
    .index("by_venue", ["venueId"])
    .index("by_faculty_day", ["facultyId", "dayOfWeek"]),

  enrollments: defineTable({
    studentId: v.id("users"),
    sectionId: v.id("sections"),
    enrolledAt: v.number(),
  })
    .index("by_student", ["studentId"])
    .index("by_section", ["sectionId"]),

  attendance_events: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    studentId: v.id("users"),
    sectionId: v.id("sections"),
    sessionId: v.optional(v.id("class_sessions")),
    state: v.union(
      v.literal("initiated"),
      v.literal("authenticated"),
      v.literal("session_verified"),
      v.literal("presence_evaluated"),
      v.literal("risk_evaluated"),
      v.literal("step_up"),
      v.literal("verified"),
      v.literal("flagged"),
      v.literal("rejected"),
      v.literal("corrected"),
    ),
    origin: v.union(v.literal("online"), v.literal("offline-faculty"), v.literal("mobile")),
    policyVersion: v.optional(v.string()),
    seq: v.number(),
    prevEventHash: v.optional(v.string()),
    eventHash: v.string(),
    correctsEventId: v.optional(v.id("attendance_events")),
    decision: v.optional(decisionValidator),
    capturedAt: v.number(),
    recordedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
    note: v.optional(v.string()),
    syncNonceHash: v.optional(v.string()),
  })
    .index("by_student_section", ["studentId", "sectionId"])
    .index("by_section_captured", ["sectionId", "capturedAt"])
    .index("by_section_state", ["sectionId", "state"])
    .index("by_institution_seq", ["institutionId", "seq"])
    .index("by_capturedAt", ["capturedAt"])
    .index("by_corrects_event", ["correctsEventId"])
    .index("by_nonce_hash", ["syncNonceHash"]),

  invites: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    email: v.string(),
    role: v.union(
      v.literal("student"),
      v.literal("faculty"),
      v.literal("department_authority"),
      v.literal("admin"),
      v.literal("auditor"),
    ),
    tokenHash: v.string(),
    status: v.union(
      v.literal("pending"),
      v.literal("accepted"),
      v.literal("revoked"),
      v.literal("expired"),
    ),
    invitedByUserId: v.id("users"),
    createdAt: v.number(),
    expiresAt: v.number(),
    acceptedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
    acceptedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
  })
    .index("by_tokenHash", ["tokenHash"])
    .index("by_institution_status", ["institutionId", "status"])
    .index("by_email", ["email"]),

  passkey_credentials: defineTable({
    userId: v.id("users"),
    credentialId: v.string(),
    publicKey: v.string(),
    counter: v.number(),
    transports: v.optional(v.array(v.string())),
    label: v.optional(v.string()),
    createdAt: v.number(),
    lastUsedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    revokedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
  })
    .index("by_credentialId", ["credentialId"])
    .index("by_user", ["userId"]),

  devices: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    userId: v.id("users"),
    label: v.string(),
    platform: v.optional(v.string()),
    state: v.union(
      v.literal("new"),
      v.literal("enrolled"),
      v.literal("active"),
      v.literal("suspended"),
      v.literal("revoked"),
      v.literal("replaced"),
    ),
    replacesDeviceId: v.optional(v.id("devices")),
    replacedByDeviceId: v.optional(v.id("devices")),
    registeredAt: v.number(),
    activatedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    stateChangedAt: v.number(),
    stateReason: v.optional(v.string()),
  })
    .index("by_user", ["userId"])
    .index("by_institution_state", ["institutionId", "state"])
    .index("by_institution_state_registered", ["institutionId", "state", "registeredAt"]),

  auth_challenges: defineTable({
    challenge: v.string(),
    purpose: v.union(v.literal("registration"), v.literal("authentication")),
    userId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
    expiresAt: v.number(),
    consumedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
  })
    .index("by_challenge", ["challenge"])
    .index("by_expiresAt", ["expiresAt"]),

  sessions: defineTable({
    userId: v.id("users"),
    tokenHash: v.string(),
    credentialId: v.optional(v.string()),
    createdAt: v.number(),
    expiresAt: v.number(),
    revokedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    lastSeenAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    lastStepUpAt: v.optional(v.number()),
  })
    .index("by_tokenHash", ["tokenHash"])
    .index("by_user", ["userId"])
    .index("by_expiresAt", ["expiresAt"]),

  device_verifications: defineTable({
    deviceId: v.id("devices"),
    codeHash: v.string(),
    expiresAt: v.number(),
    attempts: v.number(),
    consumedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
  }).index("by_device", ["deviceId"]),

  replacement_requests: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    studentId: v.id("users"),
    oldDeviceId: v.id("devices"),
    reason: v.string(),
    status: v.union(v.literal("pending"), v.literal("approved"), v.literal("rejected")),
    requestedAt: v.number(),
    decidedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
    decidedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    successorDeviceId: v.optional(v.id("devices")),
  })
    .index("by_status", ["status"])
    .index("by_student", ["studentId"])
    .index("by_status_requested", ["status", "requestedAt"])
    .index("by_institution_status_requested", ["institutionId", "status", "requestedAt"]),

  biometric_records: defineTable({
    userId: v.id("users"),
    consentVersion: v.string(),
    consentedAt: v.number(),
    faceTemplateRef: v.optional(v.string()),
    faceEnrolledAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    withdrawnAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    faceEmbedding: v.optional(v.array(v.number())),
    embeddingVersion: v.optional(v.string()),
  }).index("by_user", ["userId"]),

  verification_challenges: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    sessionId: v.id("class_sessions"),
    studentId: v.id("users"),
    kind: v.union(v.literal("checkin_stepup"), v.literal("spot_recheck")),
    originEventId: v.optional(v.id("attendance_events")),
    requestedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
    status: v.union(
      v.literal("pending"),
      v.literal("passed"),
      v.literal("failed"),
      v.literal("expired"),
      v.literal("escalated"),
    ),
    attempts: v.number(),
    createdAt: v.number(),
    expiresAt: v.number(),
    resolvedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
  })
    .index("by_student_status", ["studentId", "status"])
    .index("by_session_status", ["sessionId", "status"])
    .index("by_status_expires", ["status", "expiresAt"]),

  event_ledger: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    category: v.union(v.literal("device"), v.literal("identity"), v.literal("attendance")),
    type: v.string(),
    actorUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
    subjectUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
    deviceId: v.optional(v.id("devices")),
    payload: v.any(),
    seq: v.number(),
    prevEventHash: v.optional(v.string()),
    eventHash: v.string(),
    createdAt: v.number(),
  })
    .index("by_institution_seq", ["institutionId", "seq"])
    .index("by_subject", ["subjectUserId"])
    .index("by_subject_created", ["subjectUserId", "createdAt"])
    .index("by_subject_category_type_created", ["subjectUserId", "category", "type", "createdAt"])
    .index("by_device", ["deviceId"])
    .index("by_createdAt", ["createdAt"]),

  class_sessions: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    courseId: v.id("courses"),
    sectionId: v.id("sections"),
    venueId: v.id("venues"),
    facultyId: v.id("users"),
    kind: v.union(v.literal("scheduled"), v.literal("guest")),
    timetableSlotId: v.optional(v.id("timetable_slots")),
    status: v.union(v.literal("active"), v.literal("paused"), v.literal("closed")),
    startedAt: v.number(),
    windowEndsAt: v.number(),
    pausedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    closedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    restartOfSessionId: v.optional(v.id("class_sessions")),
    offlineKeyHash: v.optional(v.string()),
  })
    .index("by_faculty_status", ["facultyId", "status"])
    .index("by_section_started", ["sectionId", "startedAt"])
    .index("by_institution_status", ["institutionId", "status"])
    .index("by_status_windowEndsAt", ["status", "windowEndsAt"])
    .index("by_windowEndsAt", ["windowEndsAt"]),

  session_challenges: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    sessionId: v.id("class_sessions"),
    nonceHash: v.string(),
    issuedAt: v.number(),
    expiresAt: v.number(),
    consumedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    consumedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
  })
    .index("by_nonceHash", ["nonceHash"])
    .index("by_session_issued", ["sessionId", "issuedAt"])
    .index("by_expiresAt", ["expiresAt"]),

  access_requests: defineTable({
    institution: v.string(),
    name: v.string(),
    email: v.string(),
    requestedRole: v.union(
      v.literal("administrator"),
      v.literal("faculty"),
      v.literal("department_authority"),
      v.literal("other"),
    ),
    note: v.optional(v.string()),

    submittedAt: v.number(),
    reviewedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
  })
    .index("by_status_submitted", ["status", "submittedAt"])
    .index("by_email", ["email"])
    .index("by_ipHash_submitted", ["ipHash", "submittedAt"]),

  attendance_requests: defineTable({
    institutionId: v.id("institutions"),
    studentId: v.id("users"),
    type: v.union(v.literal("correction"), v.literal("exemption"), v.literal("on_duty")),
    reason: v.string(),
    status: v.union(v.literal("submitted"), v.literal("approved"), v.literal("dismissed")),
    sessionId: v.optional(v.id("class_sessions")),
    eventId: v.optional(v.id("attendance_events")),
    requestedAt: v.number(),

    reviewedByUserId: v.optional(v.id("users")),
    decision: v.optional(v.union(v.literal("approved"), v.literal("dismissed"))),

    .index("by_student_requested", ["studentId", "requestedAt"])

72:   } else if (!signals.some((s) => s.category === "presence" && s.status === "verified")) {
73:     outcome = "reject";

76:     outcome = "flag";
77:     if (failedPersonSignals.some((s) => s.detail?.startsWith("spoof_suspected"))) {
78:       reasonCodes.push(RISK_REASON_CODES.personSpoofSuspected);

81:       reasonCodes.push(RISK_REASON_CODES.personFaceMismatch);

95:   } else if (input.anomalies?.reviewRequested) {

97:     reasonCodes.push(RISK_REASON_CODES.stepupEscalatedReview);
98:   } else {
99:     const weaknesses: string[] = [];
100:     for (const signal of signals) {
101:       if (signal.category === "device" && signal.status === "weak") {
102:         weaknesses.push(RISK_REASON_CODES.deviceUntrusted);

122:       }

125:     if (weaknesses.length > 0) {
126:       outcome = "step_up";

128:     } else {
129:       outcome = "accept";
130:     }

## 12. Tamper-Evident Attendance & Correction Model

Attendance records should be treated as immutable events. Corrections should create new events rather than editing or deleting the original event.

| Event | Example |
| --- | --- |
| Original attendance | Student marked absent at 10:32 based on the session decision. |
| Correction request | Student submits a dispute with reason and supporting evidence. |
| Review decision | Authorized faculty reviews the request and records the decision. |
| Correction event | A new event changes the attendance state while preserving the original event. |
| Audit record | Actor, time, reason, previous state, new state, and policy context are retained. |

> **Important security property:** The objective is tamper evidence. Unauthorized alteration should be detectable, while legitimate corrections remain possible through signed, attributable, append-only events.

display.text:
- Manage retention, deletion, notification, biometric, and correction policies at the institution level.
- View audit history and verify that historical records remain internally consistent.

## 12. Tamper-Evident Attendance & Correction Model

Attendance records should be treated as immutable events. Corrections should create new events rather than editing or deleting the original event.

| Event | Example |
| --- | --- |
| Original attendance | Student marked absent at 10:32 based on the session decision. |
| Correction request | Student submits a dispute with reason and supporting evidence. |
| Review decision | Authorized faculty reviews the request and records the decision. |
| Correction event | A new event changes the attendance state while preserving the original event. |
| Audit record | Actor, time, reason, previous state, new state, and policy context are retained. |

> **Important security property:** The objective is tamper evidence. Unauthorized alteration should be detectable, while legitimate corrections remain possible through signed, attributable, append-only events.

## 13. Resilience & Failure Handling

| Failure condition | Required behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Network unavailable | Allow controlled offline capture using a pre-authorized class session; synchronize later. |
| GPS unavailable | Continue using classroom proximity and other valid evidence rather than failing solely on location. |
| Bluetooth/Wi-Fi unavailable | Fall back to alternate presence evidence and, where needed, faculty verification. |
| Camera or face verification failure | Allow non-biometric step-up or manual verification when policy permits. |

Wait — one more consideration: `Id` import in attendanceRequests.ts is still used? Yes: `Id<"class_sessions">`, `Id<"attendance_events">`, `Id<"sections">` in listMyCorrectionableEvents courseCodeBySection map type. ✓ And `Doc` used in requireStudent/requireDisputableEvent signatures. ✓

Also in reviewRequest dismissed branch payload: `{requestId, decision:"dismissed", eventId, previousState:null}` — spec says payload {requestId, decision, eventId, previousState}. For dismissal of a correction request, eventId exists; previousState null signals "no state change". OK.

One concern: in `listReviewQueue` returns validator — `previousReasonCodes: v.array(v.string())`. event.decision?.reasonCodes is string[]. ✓

Another: convex function return validators with optional fields — `courseCode: v.optional(v.string())` and pushing `courseCode: undefined` explicitly... In listMyRequests base rows (no eventId) I push objects WITHOUT the optional keys — good. For rows with eventId I always include `courseCode: course?.code` which may be undefined at runtime — Convex v.optional fields accept undefined values? When sending values over the wire, explicit undefined properties are stripped by convex's JSON serialization, and validators treat missing as OK for optional. Actually there's a subtlety: Convex errors on `undefined` values in objects ("undefined is not a valid value") unless field is optional — for optional fields, passing undefined is allowed? In Convex values validators, `v.optional()` means the field may be absent; an explicitly-undefined property gets dropped during serialization (JSON.stringify drops undefined props). The client/server serializes args/results via JSON, so undefined properties vanish → validator sees absent → passes. This matches existing codebase pattern: submitMyRequest inserts use conditional spreads because db.insert validates strictly server-side. But query RETURN values go through the validator too... Existing codebase precedent: history.ts has no explicit validator. classSessions.getBoard returns object with fields possibly null not undefined.

Hmm, risk: convex value validation happens on the function-return path using the defined validators against the JS object BEFORE serialization? Convex runs validation in the function gateway after serialization I believe (values must be JSON-compatible). Undefined properties are dropped by JSON serialization. So `courseCode: undefined` arrives as absent → optional validator OK. This should work.

But to be extra safe and idiomatic (matching the codebase's conditional-spread style), let me make listMyRequests build the extended part conditionally:

```ts
rows.push({
  ...base,
  eventId,
  ...(course !== null ? { courseCode: course.code } : {}),
  ...(session !== null ? { sessionStartedAt: session.startedAt } : {}),
  ...(event !== null ? { disputedState: event.state } : {}),
  ...(correction !== null ? { correctionEventId: correction._id } : {}),
});
```

That's cleaner and avoids any undefined-in-object edge cases. Note `disputedState: v.optional(v.string())` — event?.state typed as union literal; fine as string.
